concepts.gloss_en: To loosen the mouth of the mute — the power of speech, aspect of the kiss-union (זיווג הנשיקין)

concepts.canonical_he: להתיר פה אלמים להתיר פה עקרות
concepts.gloss_en: The full paired midrashic dictum (Sanhedrin 100) — releasing BOTH the mute mouth and the barren womb together

members.form: להתיר פה אלמים להתיר פה עקרות

reason_for_human: The three half-phrase occurrences (1056, 1604, 2120) all cite the same 'להתיר פה אלמים' equated with speech/kiss-union; occ 2120 is just 'נעשה בחינת' prefixed to the identical phrase, so it belongs with them. Occ 1396 is the complete paired Sanhedrin dictum covering both mute and barren, a distinct textual unit — kept separate per under-merge preference.
